name: 恶魔的宣告
desc: ①：1回合1次，支付500基本分，宣言1个卡名才能发动。把自己卡组最上面的卡翻开，是宣言的卡的场合，那张卡加入手卡。不是的场合，把翻开的卡送去墓地。
faq:
You can activate "Archfiend's Oath" while "Convulsion of Nature" is active.
If you have multiple copies of "Archfiend's Oath", you can use all of them.
ruling: "Archfiend’s Oath” is considered an Archfiend, but not an Archfiend monster, for the purpose of “Falling Down.”
